title: Xanthe and the Ghost
author: Vesper Pemberton
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
